title: Chapter 66 Immortal Clan And Immortal Emperor Clan
content:
Chapter 66 Immortal Clan And Immortal Emperor Clan

"Lord City Lord, what are those two forces?"

At this time, Gu Chen asked.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng said in a calm voice: "Well, these two forces are indeed pretty good."

"One of them is called the Immortal Clan of the Immortals, and the other is called the Immortal Emperor Clan. Both forces are forces from a long, long time ago, probably at the same time as the human race at that time."

Then, Lu Daosheng told everyone about the grand occasion of the Wanling Realm in those days.

When they learned that the human race was destroyed because they refused to surrender to the other party, everyone in the whole hall was silent for a long time.

It turned out that the human race was destroyed in this way.

"Lord City Lord, then that world alliance, should we prepare in advance?"

The world alliance destroyed the three major forces of the human race at that time, so the next one is likely to be them.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said: "Aren't we preparing now?"

The strength of this world alliance is indeed terrifying. It is a bit of a fantasy to want to compete with the other party with the current strength of the deserted city.

After all, the human race, which was so powerful back then, did not stop the other side.

Of course, all of this is based on the premise that Lu Daosheng does not take action.

If Lu Daosheng takes action personally, the World Alliance may be finished now.

At the same time, in a forbidden area in the Wanling Realm.

Here, there is an ancient and powerful force that has been sleeping here for a long time, and this place has gradually evolved into a forbidden area as time goes by.

The Immortal Clan!

The characteristics of this clan are that they have powerful immortal power and their lifespan is also ridiculously high.

It’s a pity that this clan encountered the invincible human race back then, and finally had no choice but to become the foil of the human race.

The immortal power, in the Wanling Realm at that time, was second only to the amazing power cultivated by the human race.

Buzz——

As the light curtain opened, a white-haired old man slowly walked out of it, wearing a white robe, as if he was really an immortal.

At this time, a middle-aged man appeared behind him.

"Chief, the clan members are basically awake."

Hearing this, the white-haired old man nodded.

He is the patriarch of the Immortal Clan of the Longevity, Li Changyue.

A terrifying strong man in the Heavenly Fate Realm.

On the spot, the old man looked towards the direction of the Wasteland, the direction of the Wasteland City. After a long silence, the old man slowly said: "Prepare the gifts and prepare to go to the Wasteland City."

Hearing this, the middle-aged man did not ask at all, but just nodded and said: "Yes, patriarch."

Part of their Immortal Clan of the Longevity had revived a long time ago.

And they basically knew what had happened in the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm in recent years.

The name of the Lord of the Wasteland City is invincible, and it is even more permeated throughout the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm.

Thinking of the other party killing the Heavenly Court warrior in one blow, the old man was a little palpitating.

Although he could also defeat a Heavenly Court warrior, he could never kill him in one blow.

Above the Heavenly Fate Realm.

"Lord of the Wasteland City, who are you?"

The old man looked at the direction of the Wasteland City and muttered to himself.

Another forbidden area.

Here is the territory of the Immortal Emperor Clan.

The Undead Emperor Clan is also easy to understand. They have extremely strong vitality. Immortality may be a bit exaggerated, but as long as their strength is not much greater than that of the Undead Emperor Clan, it is extremely difficult to kill a member of the Undead Emperor Clan.

And it is precisely because of this that the Undead Emperor Clan is extremely arrogant.

"Prepare gifts and go to the Wasteland City."

The Undead Emperor Clan leader, Di Ming, spoke directly as soon as he woke up.

The Undead Emperor Clan is indeed arrogant, but as the patriarch, he cannot, because any decision he makes will affect the entire Undead Emperor Clan.

Hearing this, a member of the Undead Emperor Clan frowned slightly.

"Patriarch, that Wasteland City is indeed quite capable, but in this case, isn't that us showing weakness to them?"

Another member of the Undead Emperor Clan also echoed: "Yes, patriarch, my Undead Emperor Clan may not be able to beat that Wasteland City, but we are not afraid of them."

As soon as the voice fell.

With a snap!

They were greeted by two crisp slaps.

"You are the clan leader and I am the clan leader?!"

The two of them felt a burning pain on their faces, and they covered their faces and said aggrievedly: "You, you are the clan leader."

"Why don't you get ready!"

"Yes, yes, yes."

Then the two of them fled away from here.

At the original place, Di Ming looked at the direction of the deserted city, as if he thought of something, and turned his head to look in another direction, with a slight smile on his face.

.........

Not long after, a huge shock occurred in the Wanling Realm.

The area in the center of the Wanling Realm suddenly emitted a sacred breath.

Immediately afterwards, three terrifying heaven and earth phenomena appeared in different directions.

These three positions are connected to each other, forming a stable triangle.

"Finally appeared in the world."

Somewhere in the Wanling Realm, a murmur sounded.

In the deserted city, Lu Daosheng suddenly opened his eyes, and then waved his hand, and a figure appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

Empty.

At this time, the breath of the air was particularly compelling.

At this moment, he had reached the realm of destiny.

Breaking the Heaven Realm!

This speed is hard to match in the past, present and future.

"Lord City Lord!"

Seeing Lu Daosheng, Kong did not have any pride of just breaking through, but saluted directly.

Lu Daosheng nodded.

It must be said that Kong has been giving him surprises since he saved him.

"Kong, this time the remains of the three major forces of the human race have appeared in the world, you are responsible for watching in secret to prevent any accidents."

Lu Daosheng explained.

Upon hearing this, Kong nodded and said, "My Lord, I understand."

"Go."

Immediately, Kong disappeared into the hall.

He was in place, Lu Daosheng smiled. It was unexpected that Kong could break through to the Breaking Air Realm in such a short time.

In this way, Lu Daosheng would be more at ease with Gu Chen and the others.

The realm of Breaking Heaven is enough in the current world of all spirits.

Lu Daosheng could easily sense that, except for a few special existences, none of the entire world of all spirits had reached the Heaven-Breaking Realm.

And those special existences cannot deal with empty things.

At this moment, An Xing came to the hall.

"Sir, two groups of forces have come from outside the city and want to see you."

An Xing said respectfully.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Then let them come in."

"Yes, Lord City Lord."

Looking at the direction outside the city, Lu Daosheng seemed to be smiling.

Outside the city.

"Haha, I didn't expect that your immortal clan would come here too."

Emperor Ming, the leader of the Immortal Emperor clan, looked at the people of the Changsheng Immortal Clan and sneered.

Since ancient times, the two tribes have been somewhat inconsistent.

If it weren't for the human race above, they wouldn't have dared to do it easily, otherwise they would have fought long ago.

Hearing Di Ming's mockery, Li Changyue snorted and said, "What, you can only come from the Immortal Clan, so don't you allow me to come from the Immortal Clan?"

"Hahaha, don't you all claim to be immortals and look down on others? Why are you so proactive this time? You didn't see you like this when the human race was still there."

Upon hearing this, Li Changyue had not spoken yet, and the other people from the Changsheng Immortal Clan couldn't help it.

Seeing this, Li Changyue hurriedly grabbed them.

"Class leader,"

Li Changyue shook his head, "Don't pay attention to them, don't forget our purpose this time."

When Di Ming saw Li Changyue like this, he sneered and said nothing.

Just say a few words, but it will be bad for both of them if they really fight.

At this time, they looked at the magnificent city in front of them.

At this moment, they were all feeling a little upside down.

They didn't expect that this city would be so terrifying.

Especially the plaque above the city gate, the terrifying taboo aura emitted on it made them feel a little trembling.

"Wait, it seems that the ancient divine gold has been involved in this city wall!"

Ancient Divine Gold!

An extremely rare and hard material is often an indispensable material for refining magical artifacts.

Their Immortal Imperial Clan only managed to get such a small piece back then.

And this city wall actually incorporates ancient divine gold on it, which is a waste of resources!

However, at this time, Li Changyue exclaimed: "No!"

"The entire city wall is made of ancient divine gold!"

......

Suddenly, the scene suddenly became quiet.
